title: Reconstruct Transcendence as exact HC base plus overlay
claim: Current Transcendence can be reconstructed exactly from a pinned HC base plus an explicit overlay. One real HC main→PR22 base upgrade has low overlay churn, and a bounded replay of ten real HC shared-path transitions shows mostly convergent behavior, but future maintenance economics and unbiased conflict rates remain unproven.

consumers.role: pinned candidate base bytes only; no downstream semantic authority
exact target and independently owned research overlay

preserved_boundaries: Transcendence-specific BCI, continuity, human-state archive, privacy, threat-model, and experimental material remains independently owned.
No duplicated file is removed and no repository dependency is created by the experiment.
The HC base is an exact pinned byte subject, not a moving branch or semantic authority.
HC-only paths are explicit deletions; later HC cognitive/runtime features do not silently enter Transcendence.
promotion_evidence: Stable main↔main comparison: 255 of 263 Transcendence files are identical at the same paths, accounting for 1,718,257 of 1,802,005 target bytes (95.352510121%).
Current HC PR #22 ↔ Transcendence PR #7 comparison: 254 of 288 Transcendence files are identical at the same paths, accounting for 1,706,224 of 1,992,586 target bytes (85.628625314%).
Current exact overlay payload is 34 files / 286,362 bytes (14.371374686% of target bytes), plus 39 explicit deletions.
Complete path/mode/blob snapshots and an executable recursive Git-tree reconstruction validator are staged in this exact Discovery successor.

Discovery PR #15 exact head b1e915dc4cab9a2ef32c8dd4eff8d153a1fd82a5 passed hosted runs 35514694846 and 35514694861; recursive Git hashing proved exact pinned-base-plus-overlay reconstruction to Transcendence tree 112a44d8042556b87f19b3dac05ec34a5ea2f796.

HC main 618245b54fb923c7a204892c6953ab6d1c5dac57 → HC PR #22 5929da3e8904e23e484df0deac920a008ec33d52 changes 8 overlay instructions; payload stays 34 files / 286,362 bytes; two new motor-control paths become explicit deletions.
In the first real base-upgrade simulation, 65 of 73 current overlay instructions remain unchanged and no currently shared inherited Transcendence path is touched.

Ten selected real HC historical transitions on paths shared at the current frontier remove nine overlay instructions; one executed-dataflow transition creates a transient override that disappears on the next real HC modification.
rejection_conditions: A future HC upgrade that changes currently inherited shared bytes produces large recurring override/review/qualification burden.
A forward-observed sequence shows Transcendence frequently diverges intentionally from HC on currently shared base paths.
The dependency materially increases failure, migration, qualification, or provenance risk.
A dependency implementation cannot preserve an exact pinned base, explicit deletion manifest, and standalone reconstructibility.
Transcendence loses the ability to fork or replace HC-derived mechanisms independently.

critical_objections: The exact reconstruction result is strong source-factorization evidence, but a source factorization is not yet an adopted dependency.
The current main→PR22 upgrade is an easy case because none of the eight HC changes touch a path the fixed target currently inherits unchanged.
The ten-transition historical replay is conditioned on paths known to be shared today, producing survivorship/selection bias and no unbiased future conflict-rate estimate.
Transcendence provenance explicitly states the exact original upstream HC import commit is unknown; similarity and historical replay may not invent that lineage.
The 39-file deletion set and 9 same-path overrides prove intentional divergence; moving-base inheritance without exact pins would be unsafe.
Adoption remains unjustified until forward-observed base changes and review/qualification costs show sustained maintenance benefit.

notes: EXACT_PINNED_BASE_PLUS_OVERLAY_RECONSTRUCTION is established at Discovery PR #15 exact head.
Current frontier: 85.628625314% of Transcendence target bytes are identical to HC; overlay payload is 14.371374686% plus explicit deletions.
First real base-upgrade result: LOW_CHURN_FIRST_UPGRADE; 8/73 current instructions change, payload bytes remain constant.
Historical replay: 10 real HC transitions selected from currently shared paths; 9 land directly on current target, one transient conflict converges on the next HC change.
Historical replay is compatibility evidence only, not an unbiased forecast and not original-import lineage proof.
Candidate remains EXPERIMENTING. Next evidence must be forward-observed maintenance/review cost rather than more retrospective cherry-picking.
